decision.summary: The Federal Reserve lowered the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to a range of 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.

changes.quote: In support of its goals and in light of the shift in the balance of risks, the Committee decided to lower the target range for the federal funds rate by 1/4 percentage point to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.
changes.explanation: The Fed lowered its benchmark interest rate range down to 3-1/2 to 3-3/4 percent.

changes.quote: Job gains have slowed this year, and the unemployment rate has edged up through September.
changes.explanation: The statement updates the employment picture to reflect data through September.

changes.quote: In considering the extent and timing of additional adjustments to the target range for the federal funds rate, the Committee will carefully assess incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks.
changes.explanation: The Fed added language about considering the extent and timing of future rate moves.

changes.quote: The Committee judges that reserve balances have declined to ample levels and will initiate purchases of shorter-term Treasury securities as needed to maintain an ample supply of reserves on an ongoing basis.
changes.explanation: The Fed removed its previous announcement about ending securities reductions and stated it will start buying shorter-term Treasury securities to keep bank reserves ample.

tone_quotes.quote: The Committee is attentive to the risks to both sides of its dual mandate and judges that downside risks to employment rose in recent months.
Inflation has moved up since earlier in the year and remains somewhat elevated.

for_you.text: On a $5,000 card balance at about 21.39% APR, a 25 bp cut lowers monthly interest by about $1.04.

Mortgages track the 10-year Treasury yield, not the fed funds rate. The 10-year was 4.13% and moved -5 bp on the day; if that move passed through, the payment on a new $300,000 30-year loan at 6.23% would fall by about $9.74 a month.
High-yield savings rates usually follow the Fed partly; on $10,000 that means roughly $15.00 a year less in interest.
Unemployment was 4.5%, and employers added an average of -8k jobs a month over the prior 3 months.

for_country.text: CPI inflation was 3% over the past year (November 2025); core PCE inflation, the Fed's preferred gauge, was 2.7%, against a 2% goal.
Real GDP grew at a 3.9% annualized pace in the latest reported quarter.
The 2-year Treasury yield, the most Fed-sensitive market rate, moved -7 bp on the day, and the S&P 500 moved 0.67%.
The broad trade-weighted dollar moved -0.01% on the day.

whats_next: The statement signals that future policy adjustments will depend heavily on incoming data, the evolving outlook, and the balance of risks. An educational forecast model estimates a 65% chance of a hold and a 35% chance of a cut at the next meeting.
